## History

Kit was transitioned into short clothes by [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) and [Lorna](../character/lorna-vane.md). Shortly thereafter, the family packed up the house in October, and Kit departed from the home alongside [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) and Hugh as they moved to a new property.
